identity.what_it_is: Urban Blue Flag beach in central Albufeira, Algarve, reached by a pedestrian tunnel, a public elevator, and cliffside stairs; named after a large detached sandstone boulder (a 'peneco') sitting on the sand.
identity.where: Algarve south coast, municipality of Albufeira, Portugal; about 38.5 km (23.9 miles) by road west of Faro.
identity.warnings: EN Wikipedia's canonical article title is 'Praia do Túnel (Peneco)'; PT Wikipedia uses 'Praia do Peneco'. Both names are in wide official and press use (cm-albufeira.pt uses 'Peneco'; visitportugal.com uses 'Praia do Túnel ou Peneco') — one beach, two names, not a duplicate. No near-duplicate 'Peneco' beach found elsewhere in Portugal.

spike_candidates.statement: The sandstone boulder that gives Praia do Peneco its name cracked in storms, and Albufeira's mayor said on 20 Feb 2026 it will 'in principle' be demolished.
spike_candidates.tension: To make the beach safe, officials may destroy the very landmark the beach is named after, and as of 14 March 2026 its fate is still undecided.

spike_candidates.statement: A March 2026 APA survey measured a 24-metre beach recession at Praia do Peneco, the worst berm retreat recorded anywhere in southern Portugal.
spike_candidates.tension: The APA is racing an official pre-summer 2026 deadline to armor and re-access the very cliffs and sand the town's tourist economy depends on.

spike_candidates.statement: The Elevador do Peneco carries two conflicting official inauguration dates: 'in operation since June 2008' (PT Wikipedia) versus 20 May 2009 (municipal/press releases).
spike_candidates.tension: A landmark built with EU public money and marketed to tourists doesn't have an agreed birthdate in its own official record.

facts.fact: The beach is officially titled 'Praia do Túnel (Peneco)' on English Wikipedia but is widely known as Praia do Peneco, forming the western half of Albufeira's seafront with Praia dos Pescadores to the east.
facts.quote: the beach is also known as praia do peneco and is one of the two beaches which front the town of albufeira with praia do túnel at the western end and praia dos pescadores lying to the eastern end of the towns seafront.
facts.source_title: Praia do Túnel (Peneco) - Wikipedia

facts.fact: Albufeira and its beaches lie about 23.9 miles (38.5 km) by road west of Faro, the Algarve's regional capital.
facts.quote: the town and its beaches are located west 23.9 miles (38.5 km) by road of the regions capital of faro
facts.source_title: Praia do Túnel (Peneco) - Wikipedia

facts.fact: The 'Túnel' name comes from a roughly 20-metre pedestrian tunnel cut through the cliff next to Albufeira's tourist office, linking the old town square to the sand.
facts.quote: the beach gets its name from a 20 meter long tunnel next to the tourist office in the middle of albufeira which cuts through the cliffs linking the towns square to the beach.
facts.source_title: Praia do Túnel (Peneco) - Wikipedia

facts.fact: Albufeira's own municipal beach page explains the 'Peneco' name: a large detached boulder (leixão) sits on the sand resisting the cliff's general retreat, and such rock formations are locally called 'penecos'.
facts.quote: um enorme leixão encontra-se no areal, resistindo ao recuo generalizado da arriba e constituindo um elemento distintivo da praia, já que estas formações rochosas são designadas localmente por "penecos"
facts.source_title: Peneco | Município de Albufeira

facts.fact: At the western end of the beach a promenade leads to the Xorino Grotto, which 13th-century legend says sheltered Moors after the Christian conquest of Albufeira.
facts.quote: according to 13th-century legend, the cave was used as shelter by the moors after the christian conquest of albufeira.
facts.source_title: Praia do Túnel (Peneco) - Wikipedia

facts.fact: Portugal's official tourism board likewise describes the Xorino Grotto at the promenade's end as a believed Moorish refuge following the 13th-century Christian conquest of Albufeira.
facts.quote: the promenade ends at the pretty xorino grotto believed to have been used as a safe haven by moors following the christian conquest of albufeira in the 13th century.
facts.source_title: Praia do Túnel ou Peneco | visitportugal.com

facts.fact: In 1989 a section of the cliff at Praia do Peneco collapsed, killing one man and seriously injuring his girlfriend.
facts.quote: evitando tragédias como a 1989 quando a queda de um troço provocou a morte de um homem e ferimentos graves na sua namorada
facts.source_title: Praia do Peneco em risco de perder... o Peneco - Sul Informação

facts.fact: In 2022 the stairway and cliff face above the beach, at Esplanada Dr. Frutuoso da Silva, underwent a roughly €1.5 million preservation project that built the current staircase.
facts.quote: em 2022, a zona da praia do peneco foi alvo de obras de preservação e conservação da escadaria e arriba, na esplanada dr. frutuoso da silva. a intervenção custou cerca de 1,5 milhões de euros e criou a nova escadaria
facts.source_title: Praia do Peneco em risco de perder... o Peneco - Sul Informação

facts.fact: Portuguese Wikipedia states the Elevador do Peneco has been in public operation since June 2008, run by Albufeira's municipal council, built with EU FEDER/Programa Polis funding of about €687,000.
facts.quote: a sua construção teve apoio financeiro do fundo europeu de desenvolvimento regional ( feder ), ao abrigo do programa polis de albufeira, para um custo de 687 mil euros
facts.source_title: Elevador do Peneco - Wikipédia

facts.fact: The Elevador do Peneco is 28 metres tall, carries up to 13 people, and was designed by architect João Castro Ferreira.
facts.quote: tem uma altura de 28 m e pode comportar 13 pessoas, tendo tido como arquiteto joão castro ferreira
facts.source_title: Elevador do Peneco - Wikipédia

facts.fact: Municipal and press sources from November 2023 date the elevator's inauguration to 20 May 2009, a year later than Portuguese Wikipedia's 'in operation since June 2008' claim.
facts.quote: inaugurado em 20 de maio de 2009, o elevador do peneco «vale pela utilidade que proporciona a quem vive ou está de férias nesta zona de albufeira e pretende ir à praia, permitindo também o acesso a quem se move em cadeiras de rodas
facts.source_title: Albufeira investe 66 mil euros no tratamento e pintura do Elevador do Peneco

facts.fact: In November 2023 Albufeira council contracted €66,334.55 of metalwork treatment and repainting for the Elevador do Peneco structure, due to finish by February 2024.
facts.quote: a obra traduz-se num investimento de 66.334,55 euros e consiste sobretudo no tratamento e pintura das partes metálicas que sofrem com a proximidade do mar
facts.source_title: Estrutura do elevador do Peneco em obras de tratamento e de pintura

facts.fact: The Elevador do Peneco is free to use and normally runs daily from 08:00 to 21:00.
facts.quote: diariamente entre as 08h00 e as 21h00 horas
facts.source_title: Estrutura do elevador do Peneco em obras de tratamento e de pintura

facts.fact: The municipality's beach page states pedestrian access is via a tunnel cut through the limestone cliff, or via the stairway to the west.
facts.quote: o acesso ao areal é pedonal e feito a partir do centro antigo de albufeira, através de um túnel escavado na arriba calcária ou da escadaria a poente
facts.source_title: Peneco | Município de Albufeira

facts.fact: The same municipal page notes a further access option: a public elevator located in the Rossio area of the old town.
facts.quote: é também possível aceder à praia através de um elevador situado na zona do rossio
facts.source_title: Peneco | Município de Albufeira

facts.fact: During the summer bathing season the beach is patrolled by lifeguards, and loungers, parasols, and pedalos are available to hire.
facts.quote: during the summer season the beach is patrolled by lifeguards . there are loungers, parasols and pedalo's which can be hired.
facts.source_title: Praia do Túnel (Peneco) - Wikipedia

facts.fact: English Wikipedia notes the beach has good access for disabled visitors.
facts.quote: the beach has good access for the disabled
facts.source_title: Praia do Túnel (Peneco) - Wikipedia

facts.fact: On 20 February 2026 Albufeira mayor Rui Cristina said the cracked 'peneco' rock that names the beach will 'in principle' be demolished, after drone inspection found a fissure splitting it.
facts.quote: «foi filmado com drone, o penedo tem uma fissura ao meio e é perigoso. é um ex-libris, mas há essa grande probabilidade», disse o autarca.
facts.source_title: Praia do Peneco em risco de perder... o Peneco - Sul Informação

facts.fact: A safety perimeter was marked off around the cracked rock to keep bathers from approaching it.
facts.quote: foi delimitado um perímetro de segurança para evitar que os banhistas se aproximem
facts.source_title: Rochedo emblemático da Praia do Peneco pode ser demolido

facts.fact: On 4 March 2026 Environment Minister Maria da Graça Carvalho called cliff-stabilization work on the Algarve coast, including at Praia do Peneco, 'necessary and super urgent' for beachgoer safety.
facts.quote: a intervenção nas arribas é um dos projetos "necessários e super urgente para garantir a segurança de quem visita as praias"
facts.source_title: Pode ruir a qualquer momento: rochedo que dá nome a uma praia no Algarve - Postal

facts.fact: Mayor Rui Cristina described the Peneco rock as 'something very symbolic, an emblematic rock that represents Albufeira,' while conceding the technical decision rests with specialists.
facts.quote: algo muito simbólico, uma rocha emblemática que representa albufeira
facts.source_title: Pode ruir a qualquer momento: rochedo que dá nome a uma praia no Algarve - Postal

facts.fact: The Environment Minister said she would request support from Portugal's National Laboratory for Civil Engineering (LNEC) to help decide on an intervention for the rock.
facts.quote: maria da graça carvalho indicou que irá solicitar o apoio do laboratório nacional de engenharia civil (lnec) para "apoiar numa decisão" sobre a intervenção a realizar no local
facts.source_title: Pode ruir a qualquer momento: rochedo que dá nome a uma praia no Algarve - Postal

facts.fact: A March 2026 Portuguese Environment Agency (APA) report found Praia do Peneco suffered the worst beach-berm recession measured in southern Portugal: a maximum retreat of 24 metres.
facts.quote: o caso mais preocupante no sul do país foi observado na praia do peneco (albufeira) com um recuo máximo da berma da praia de 24 metros
facts.source_title: Algarve com 35 praias afetadas por instabilidade em arribas - Observador

facts.fact: By comparison, the same APA survey measured a maximum recession of 15 metres at Loulé Velho-Trafal, 14 metres at Quarteira-Garrão, and 6 metres at Forte Novo.
facts.quote: outros casos assinalados são o do recuo máximo local de 15 metros detetado na praia de loulé velho - trafal, de 14 metros na praia de quarteira-garrão (loulé) e de seis metros na praia do forte novo (loulé).
facts.source_title: Algarve com 35 praias afetadas por instabilidade em arribas - Observador

facts.fact: The APA report put estimated coastal damage nationwide at about €27 million requiring immediate intervention, plus further mid-term structural work.
facts.quote: os prejuízos estimados na faixa costeira do país, em termos de danos, ascendem a cerca de 27 milhões de euros
facts.source_title: Algarve com 35 praias afetadas por instabilidade em arribas - Observador

facts.fact: Albufeira registered 23 storm-damage occurrences between October and early March, the most of any Algarve municipality, with 18 of them cliff-instability cases including at Praia do Peneco.
facts.quote: por concelho, albufeira foi o município algarvio com mais ocorrências (23), a maioria relativas a instabilidades em arribas (18), nas praias da balbina, são rafael, peneco, santa eulália, balaia, maria luísa, olhos de água e barranco das belharucas.
facts.source_title: Litoral algarvio com 25 intervenções prioritárias para concluir até ao verão

facts.fact: The APA's pre-summer 2026 priority plan for Albufeira includes repairing access and marking off the risk zone at Praia do Peneco, while the fate of the rock formation naming the beach remains undecided.
facts.quote: para albufeira, está prevista a reparação do acesso e balizamento da zona de risco da praia do peneco, não se sabendo ainda o destino da formação rochosa que dá nome à zona balnear
facts.source_title: Litoral algarvio com 25 intervenções prioritárias para concluir até ao verão

facts.fact: APA earmarked €15 million from Portugal's environmental fund for urgent Algarve coastal works to finish before the 2026 bathing season, part of a wider ~€111 million national coastal investment plan.
facts.quote: para mitigar estes danos, a apa definiu um conjunto de «intervenções de urgência», a concluir até ao início da época balnear, no valor de 15 milhões de euros, financiados pelo fundo ambiental
facts.source_title: Litoral algarvio com 25 intervenções prioritárias para concluir até ao verão

facts.fact: The storms that damaged the Algarve coast since October 2025 were named Ingrid, Joseph, Kristin, Leonardo and Marta.
facts.quote: os temporais que se verificaram desde outubro (ingrid, joseph, kristin, leonardo e marta) produziram «impactos significativos na morfologia costeira»
facts.source_title: Litoral algarvio com 25 intervenções prioritárias para concluir até ao verão

facts.fact: ECO described the Peneco rock, which gives the beach its name, as facing possible demolition after storm damage, calling it a 'natural monument.'
facts.quote: não está excluída a necessidade de demolição deste monumento natural
facts.source_title: Praias do Algarve recuaram até 24 metros. Há 35 afetadas pelo mau tempo - ECO

facts.fact: Praia do Peneco (municipal beach code PTCL2Q) holds Blue Flag status for the 2026 season, running 1 July to 30 September within a bathing season of 15 May to 15 October 2026.
facts.quote: época balnear: 15/05/2026 a 15/10/2026 época bandeira azul: 01/07/2026 a 30/09/2026
facts.source_title: Peneco - Bandeira Azul

facts.fact: Portugal's official tourism board lists the beach's facilities as an EEC Blue Flag beach with security/surveillance, sunshade rental, small craft hire, showers, outdoor parking, a bar/restaurant, windsurfing, and full accessibility.
facts.quote: eec blue flag security or surveillance sunshade rental small craft hire showers outdoor parking bar restaurant windsurfing accessible beach
facts.source_title: Praia do Túnel ou Peneco | visitportugal.com

facts.fact: Visit Portugal lists the average summer seawater temperature at the beach as 20-23°C.
facts.quote: average seawater temperature in summer (oc) : 20-23 oc
facts.source_title: Praia do Túnel ou Peneco | visitportugal.com

facts.fact: A tourism blog gives a different summer water-temperature range for the beach, 19-22°C (66-72°F), versus Visit Portugal's 20-23°C.
facts.quote: in summer, the water is typically between 19°c and 22°c (66-72°f)
facts.source_title: Praia do Túnel (Peneco): Best Guide - Algarve Tips

facts.fact: A beach bar called Roca Beach Bar was built at the beach in 2018, offering lunch, ice cream, and free toilet facilities.
facts.quote: in 2018, the construction of a new beach bar was completed. it is called roca beach bar . you can have lunch here, buy ice cream or grab a cold beer.
facts.source_title: Praia do Túnel (Peneco): Best Guide - Algarve Tips

facts.fact: A travel blog names three restaurants within walking distance as local favorites: Os Arcos (Portuguese/seafood), Jaipur (Indian), and Oishi (sushi/Japanese) — unverified by any second source.
facts.quote: os arcos . this portuguese restaurant is a favourite among locals. it offers fabulous fresh fish and great service.
facts.source_title: Praia do Túnel (Peneco): Best Guide - Algarve Tips

facts.fact: For GPS navigation, the beach address is given as Esplanada Dr. Frutuoso da Silva 9, Albufeira, with street parking near the old town noted as limited.
facts.quote: esplanada dr. frutuoso da silva 9, albufeira. you can park in the streets around the old town. parking spots can however be limited.
facts.source_title: Praia do Túnel (Peneco): Best Guide - Algarve Tips

facts.fact: A tourism blog warns the water gets deep quickly and currents can be strong, urging caution with small children, though conditions can be good for surfing.
facts.quote: the water gets deep very quickly. but in general, praia do túnel is a great beach for families and couples
facts.source_title: Praia do Túnel (Peneco): Best Guide - Algarve Tips

facts.fact: Praia do Túnel (Peneco) is bounded on its east side by Praia dos Pescadores at a large rock, with the two beaches forming Albufeira's town seafront together.
facts.quote: praia dos pescadores begins at the big rock, which means that everything until the big rock is praia do túnel.
facts.source_title: Praia do Túnel (Peneco): Best Guide - Algarve Tips

facts.fact: Portuguese Wikipedia describes the beach as overcrowded in summer, with parking shortages and traffic, and water quality that has 'not always' been good though it has improved in recent years.
facts.quote: a falta de lugares para estacionar e o tráfego são problemas que se juntam à nem sempre tão boa qualidade da água (que tem melhorado nos últimos anos)
facts.source_title: Praia do Peneco - Wikipédia

recency.newest_item: Alentejo Sul Informação (14 March 2026) reports APA's plan of 25 priority Algarve coastal interventions before summer 2026, including repairing beach access and marking the risk zone at Praia do Peneco, while the fate of the namesake rock remains undecided.

No sourced material on the beach's wildlife/species (e.g., gulls, geckos) — any such claims should be treated as unverified.
No sourced material on named events specific to Praia do Peneco itself; New Year's Eve concerts and named events were found only for the neighboring Praia dos Pescadores.
No official current lifeguard staffing counts, visitor/tourist numbers, or exact count of loungers/concessions on the beach.
No sourced driving directions or road distance from Faro airport specifically, beyond the general 38.5 km Albufeira-Faro town distance.
